faults.post-release-push: cube external force +x 1N during8.0<=t<8.08; no teleport
faults.false-good-report: grip stuck closed after6.5; one forged settled/no-finger packet at6.602

exit: Same E7 phase-aware stop predicate. Apply held target next tick. open sets grip0; open-retreat opens then after200ms raises target100mm over600ms smoothstep. These are candidate exit actions, not certified safe stops.
release_contract: Observe only, no policy feedback. Single passing fresh capture vs consecutive fresh20ms captures spanning>=250ms, after commanded release and prior lift>100mm; support bin_floor, no fingers, XY/Z and speed. Success latches; final truth checked independently.
recovery_contract: Reuse E5 fresh post-hold100ms gate; monitor transfer. Resume replan from measured hand over500ms then original lower/release/retreat. Cap2 vs cap2+400ms min hold; 800ms hold deadline wins. All gaps tied to absolute simulation time, policy exposure can differ.
design: 32 deterministic physical rollouts, one per cell. E9 applies two observational completion rules to the same five trajectories. No randomized success-rate inference, no robot hardware/vision/ROS2.
